courses.title: Introduction to Microcontrollers
courses.shortDescription: The full Flowcode + E-blocks 3 introduction to microcontroller programming. 12 bronze/silver/gold worksheets plus sensor, motor, and assessment screens spanning analogue I/O, interrupts, displays, and web mirror projects.

courses.title: Motors and Microcontrollers
courses.shortDescription: Five worksheets on motor control with Flowcode and E-blocks 3 — basic DC motors, full bridge control, stepper and servo motors, plus closed-loop speed control.

courses.title: Sensors and Microcontrollers
courses.shortDescription: Eleven worksheets covering analogue and digital sensors with Flowcode and E-blocks 3 — from light and temperature sensors to accelerometers, flow rate, force, strain and pressure.

courses.title: Microcontrollers for T-Levels
courses.shortDescription: T-Level Engineering microcontroller worksheet pack — Flowcode + E-blocks 3, compiled from the CP4807 / CP1972 / CP0507 worksheet base.

courses.title: Introduction to Microcontrollers
courses.shortDescription: The 12-worksheet master pack underpinning CO0001, CO0002, CO0003 and CO0004. Bronze, Silver and Gold tiered worksheets from first program through web mirror projects.

courses.title: Digital Techniques for Aviation Technicians
courses.shortDescription: EASA Unit 5 Digital Techniques worksheet pack — Flowcode + E-blocks 3, compiled from the CP4807 / CP1972 / CP0507 worksheet base.

courses.title: Flowcode and E-blocks 3 CPD Course
courses.shortDescription: A short CPD course for instructors covering how Flowcode and E-blocks 3 help students learn modern digital electronics. Videos, PowerPoints, key worksheets, and a printable CPD certificate.
